CommunityApplications.Profile:
This repo carries Unraid Community Applications templates for a handful of self-built, self-hosted tools: **claude-code** (a persistent, tmux-backed Claude Code container for driving a homelab from anywhere), Prometheus exporters for services that don't expose their own metrics (**ado-exporter** for Azure DevOps, **cloud-billing-exporter** for Azure/GCP/Hetzner spend, **semaphore-exporter** and **patchmon-exporter**), a small family of MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers bridged over HTTP with supergateway (**docker-mcp**, **filesystem-mcp**, **hass-mcp**, **tailscale-mcp**), and **homelab-runbooks**, a generic MkDocs Material docs-site template for any Markdown-based docs repo.
Each app has its own GitHub repo with the Dockerfile, source, and a full README covering configuration - linked from each template. Issues and questions go to the individual app's repo, linked from its own template.
